# The Rapaport Family Archive

> A researched family archive for Dov Bernard Rapaport's 80th birthday, 28 August 2026.
> The website is a JavaScript app and crawlers cannot read it. These files are the archive in
> plain text.

## Read this first
- [Start here](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/00-START-HERE.md): the rules and what each file holds
- [Everything in one file](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/99-EVERYTHING.md): the whole archive, one document

- [All people](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/03-people.md)

- [Conflicts and open questions](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/08-conflicts-and-open-questions.md)
- [How it was researched, and where we were wrong](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/09-research-story.md)
- [The film brief](https://rapaportfamily.github.io/llm/10-film-brief.md)
